title: chapters
description: Topic chapters of an edit's kept transcript in timeline seconds, proposed by scripts/chapters.py. The chapter rules of prompts/metadata.md apply: the first chapter starts at 0, starts never decrease, titles are at most 40 characters and mark real topic changes. export_filmcraft.py places one section marker per chapter and the publish kit can take its chapters from this file instead of asking the model again.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the file was written

tool.description: the script that wrote the file, e.g. scripts/chapters.py

chapters.description: topic chunks in timeline order; the first one always starts at 0

start_s.description: timeline start of the chapter in seconds from the start of the edit

title.description: short chapter title, at most 40 characters (the prompts/metadata.md chapter rule)

summary.description: one-line summary of what the chapter covers
